correctness.rationale: PASS — Seasonal maps F_i(x)=P_i x/(1+c_iᵀx) compose exactly to G(x)=Mx/(1+Cᵀx), where M=P_{i3}P_{i2}P_{i1} and Cᵀ=c_{i1}ᵀ+c_{i2}ᵀP_{i1}+c_{i3}ᵀP_{i2}P_{i1}. Induction gives G^k(x)=M^k x/[1+Cᵀ Σ_{j<k} M^j x]. M is strictly positive because f_i,s_i,t_i>0. Perron–Frobenius expansion for every x≥0 nonzero proves λ<1 extinction, λ=1 kx_k→v/(Cᵀv), and λ>1 attraction to the unique fixed vector (λ−1)v/(Cᵀv). Exact 2×2 multiplication gives tr(P3P2P1)−tr(P2P3P1)=det[(f_i,s_i,t_i)], common determinant −∏f_i s_i, and λ relative to one determined by T+K relative to one. Independent SymPy algebra confirmed all trace/determinant identities and exact rational season example (T123=98/125, T132=211/250, K=81/500), proving one calendar extinct and the other persistent. The full nonlinear limit and intermediate-phase continuity, not finite trajectories, give the global all-initial-data assertion.

originality.rationale: PASS, qualified. Mertens et al. 2006 already show noncyclic permutations affect growth in linear periodic matrix populations. Caswell nonlinear periodic sensitivity and Cushing–Ackleh net reproductive thresholds likewise provide antecedents. The combined explicit 3×3 orientation determinant, projectively saturated nonlinear closed iterates, universal critical 1/k rate, and strict global extinction/persistence reversal for exactly three environments were not seen as deductions of those published results. Broader positive matrix-fractional map literature remains a material subsumption risk.
residual_risks: A generic positive matrix-fractional/Beverton–Holt theorem may already imply the closed-form global trichotomy.
Trace-of-three-products orientation formulas are elementary algebra and may be known under Lie/commutator aliases.
Full Mertens and Cushing–Ackleh original paper bodies were not inspected in this run.

limitations: Requires two stages, three fixed recurring seasons, strictly positive crowding common denominators; not valid for heterogeneous matrix-entry saturation.
Calendar spectral ranking does not necessarily rank steady abundances at common observation time.
Published same-model comparisons incomplete across broad fractional-positive dynamics literature.
